answer_1.quote: Text style transfer aims to convert an input text into another generated text with a different style but the same basic semantics as the input.
answer_1.outputs: transferred text in the target style

answer_2.quote: Following previous work, we measure the style transfer accuracy using a FastText style classifier ... To measure content preservation, we use SIM and BLEU ... To measure the fluency we use a pre-trained GPT-2 model to compute the perplexity.

answer_4.quote: We conducted human evaluation on Yelp, Amazon and GYAFC datasets ... We use Amazon Turk for human evaluation. Each candidate is rated by three annotators ...
answer_4.guideline: evaluating the style transfer accuracy, content preservation, and fluency separately. The first two aspects are rated with range 1-3 while the fluency is rated with range 0-1.
